hints.title: Prime Factor Precomputation
hints.text: Extract all prime factors per element and index the positions containing each prime factor.

hints.title: Graph BFS Traversal
hints.text: Explore positions in level order using both adjacent step movements and prime factor teleportation.

hints.title: Prime Visitation Pruning
hints.text: Clear or mark each prime factor as visited after its first expansion to prevent redundant queue entries.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.time: O(N * P + M log log M)
variables: P: max prime factors per value
complexity.notes: Breadth-first search with prime factor grouping pruning edges after first visit.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-expanding all indices of previously visited prime factors causes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prime factor inverted index allows instantaneous neighbor lookups.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use BFS and prune prime factors to prevent redundant edge traversals.
